title: Poké Ball Hearts
description: Turns hearts into poké balls! Inspired by poké ball textures from Cobblemon
body:
![banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ac4cec2937c4be4e5182577bee3db604e87464c4.png)

Turns minecraft hearts into poké balls inspired by the [Cobblemon ](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)poké ball textures!

![poke ball hearts](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2166b5f2025b98e4bf8e5b418de85eab52425d99.png)



Hardcore poké ball hearts are being worked on!
